method: Complete sequential reading of Peri Tzadik, Lech Lecha 7–10 in the canonical preferred edition, including all 33 paragraphs. Every completed paragraph was compared with actually read candidate paragraphs from both Kisvei Rav Tzadok and Ishbitz–Radzin, with broader contextual readings where needed. Existing quoted forward connections were reassessed; new records are approved only for a substantive explanatory contribution. Candidate searches are discovery aids, never approval or proof that no other connection exists. Rejected and deferred placements are finite editorial assessments, and no school quota is imposed.

The approved Takanat comparison explains the later revelation of his earlier holy root; it prepares, and does not replace, the repentance from love developed in paragraph 3.
